integrity: The vertex list is independently derived from the cycle constraints and agrees with the published half-integral vertex criterion. The Euclidean optimization reduces by cycle symmetry to one scalar and is certified globally by explicit contact barycenters. Finite vertex enumeration and ambient epigraph optimization are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to cycle graphs in the standard coordinate realization of the fractional stable-set relaxation. It determines the minimum enclosing Euclidean ball and radial shells, not the inradius, John ellipsoid, or analogous sphere for arbitrary graphs.
title: Cycle fractional stable-set polytopes have a parity-split minimum sphere
